name: Cslib.FreeM.foldFreeM_unique
lines: onEffect : {ι : Type u} → F ι → (ι → β) → β
h_pure : ∀ (a : α), h (pure a) = onValue a
h_liftBind : ∀ {ι : Type u} (op : F ι) (k : ι → FreeM F α), h ((lift op).bind k) = onEffect op fun x => h (k x)
⊢ h x = foldFreeM onValue (fun {ι} => onEffect) x
⊢ h (pure a) = foldFreeM onValue (fun {ι} => onEffect) (pure a)
ih : ∀ (i : ι✝), h (k i) = foldFreeM onValue (fun {ι} => onEffect) (k i)
⊢ h ((lift op).bind k) = foldFreeM onValue (fun {ι} => onEffect) ((lift op).bind k)
⊢ (onEffect op fun x => h (k x)) = onEffect op fun x => foldFreeM onValue (fun {ι} => onEffect) (k x)

steps.tactic:
induction x with
| pure a => rw [foldFreeM_pure, h_pure]
| lift_bind op k ih =>
  rw [foldFreeM_lift_bind, h_liftBind]
  grind
